title: P1-F2 worker transaction scheduler and projection protocol

phases.label: Dispatch heavy worker transaction and urgent visible projection request
Keep the page foreground-active after scheduler/projection work completes

sop: F2 is transaction scheduler / worker projection protocol support.
F2 is not product trace replay.
F2 is not a renderer benchmark.
F2 compares monolithic worker transaction behavior against scheduled worker transaction behavior.
F2 must use the same F0-D/F1 structural workload and synthetic_pressure_multiplier=1.
No Chrome capture is allowed until no-capture and simulated audits pass.
Load the P1-F2 target and confirm visible audit state shows config_valid=true and capture_allowed=true.
Confirm scheduler_mode is monolithic for F2-A or scheduled for F2-B.
Confirm urgent_projection_enabled=true, stale_result_policy=reject, version_check_enabled=true, and no_precompute_before_click=true.
Confirm all F0-D/F1 structural workload fields match the approved baseline.
Press Enter only after the page is loaded and Chrome is foreground-active.
Do not interact with the page during capture; the target dispatches synthetic DOM pointerup/click on p0:capture:start.
The main thread must not synchronously wait for Worker completion.
Worker counters and checksum must prove equivalent heavy work before any performance interpretation.
